title: Tenant-aware sink routing + sensitive-event filtering for private audit exporter
author: Anika Shah
release_notes: Adds tenant-aware sink routing, per-tenant retention policy support, and a configurable sensitive-event filter to the private audit-log-exporter. Includes Helm chart values, Terraform module wiring, installer hooks for credential rotation, and migration/rollback tooling.
description: Motivation: Private deployments require strict per-tenant control of where audit data flows and which events are retained or redacted. Customers asked for (1) the ability to route audit events from different tenants to different sinks (local archive, S3/GS remote archive, SIEM) and (2) a configurable, auditable sensitive-event filter that prevents PII or regulated events from leaving private networks. This PR implements tenant-aware sink routing, a policy-driven sensitive-event filter, upgrade/rollback hooks in the private installer, and accompanying Terraform/Helm changes so operators can opt into the wiring with minimal manual steps. Checklist: - [x] Tenant routing engine (config-driven) - [x] Sensitive-event filter DSL + sample policies - [x] Helm chart values and templates for sink endpoints and retention - [x] Terraform module exports and examples for sink resources - [x] Private-installer hook to bind sink credentials and run post-upgrade migrations - [x] Migration script to backfill tenant mapping metadata - [x] End-to-end test harness and local e2e manifests - [x] Docs draft under docs/private/audit-exporter.md Changes are backwards-compatible by default: existing single-sink configurations continue to work. Operators may opt-in to per-tenant routing and to filter rules via values and a managed ConfigMap. Important links: Linear ENG-1892 (tenant sinks), SUP-734 (customer request), design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-1892/tenant-audit-sinks-design. How to review: Focus on the routing policy evaluation code, the installer credential hook (idempotency), and the Terraform outputs that expose sink IDs for the installer. Also validate helm value schema and validate e2e flows in the repo's perf-canary harness.
